name: N4 Bias Field Correction (T2w)
summary: Corrects intensity inhomogeneity (bias field) in a T2-weighted image with ANTs N4BiasFieldCorrection, optionally restricted to a brain mask.
description: Runs N4BiasFieldCorrection -d 3 on the T2w image, passing the mask with -x, and writes the bias-corrected image. Use it before segmentation or registration when the image shows smooth intensity non-uniformity. The mask must be aligned with the T2w image.

inputs.description: Binary brain mask passed to N4 with -x.
inputs.requirements: Must be aligned with the T2w image.

citations.text: Avants BB, Tustison NJ, Song G, et al. A reproducible evaluation of ANTs similarity metric performance in brain image registration. NeuroImage 54(3):2033-2044 (2011).
Tustison NJ, Avants BB, Cook PA, et al. N4ITK: Improved N3 bias correction. IEEE Trans Med Imaging 29(6):1310-1320 (2010).
